outreach.subject: Photo-preparation resource for your UPSC application guide
outreach.body:
Hello ClearIAS team,

Your UPSC online-application guide explains the photograph, live-photo and signature steps. I am writing from MyDocPro, a free browser-based image and PDF toolkit, with a practical resource your readers may find useful.

Our image resizer lets applicants set dimensions in pixels or physical units and prepare a downloadable image: https://mydocpro.co.in/resize-image. Selected files are processed on the user's device, and no account is required.

The tool does not replace the official upload specifications or live-photo process. If it proves useful after your review, would you consider mentioning it as an optional preparation resource in your guide?

Thank you,
MyDocPro
https://mydocpro.co.in/

outreach.subject: Calculator resource for Shotkit's photo-resolution guide
outreach.body:
Hello Shotkit team,

Your photo-resolution guide explains how pixel dimensions relate to physical print size. I am writing from MyDocPro to suggest a small companion resource for readers who want to apply those calculations.

Our free calculator converts centimetres, millimetres or inches to pixels at a chosen DPI, and converts pixels back to physical dimensions: https://mydocpro.co.in/cm-to-pixels. It also provides photo-size tables and links to a pre-filled image resizer.

Would you consider reviewing it as an optional resource alongside the guide? Any mention or link would be entirely at your editorial discretion.

Thank you,
MyDocPro
https://mydocpro.co.in/

listing.name: MyDocPro
listing.tagline: Free image and PDF tools that process files in your browser
listing.description:
MyDocPro is a free browser-based toolkit for preparing images, PDFs and application photos. Resize images in pixels, centimetres, millimetres or inches; compress photos toward a target file size; crop and convert images; and use photo-size guides and a CM-to-pixels calculator.

The PDF tools support merging, splitting, organizing and compressing PDFs, as well as image-to-PDF and PDF-to-image conversion. Selected files are processed on the user's device. No account is required, and the tools do not add a watermark.

MyDocPro is designed for everyday paperwork, such as preparing form attachments, arranging scanned documents and sizing photos. Users should check downloaded files against the receiving organization's requirements.
